title: Bank Officer KYC Suspension & AnyDesk Scam
description: Simulates a scammer posing as an SBI/HDFC bank manager claiming the victim's account is suspended unless they install AnyDesk and disclose OTP.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Good afternoon, I am calling from State Bank of India customer service head office.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Your banking services and debit card will be permanently blocked within 1 hour due to pending KYC verification.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Please open Google Play Store and install AnyDesk or QuickSupport application right now so our executive can assist you.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: Share your 9 digit AnyDesk code. Now open your mobile banking app and enter your UPI PIN to approve the security certificate.

turns.speaker: Caller (Scammer)
turns.text: A 6-digit OTP has been sent by the bank. Read the OTP aloud immediately to complete the unfreezing process.
